2610.06423.title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
2610.06423.paper_summary: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.
2610.06423.paper_summary_zh: 自發性運動分析在早產嬰兒中越來越依賴無標記姿勢估計（PE），以直接從視頻錄像中推導出臨床相關的運動生物標記。訓練準確的嬰兒PE模型需要大量手動標註的關鍵點，而人類標註本質上容易出錯。在這種臨床環境中，噪聲關鍵點（即相對於其真實解剖位置錯位的關鍵點）特別成為問題，因為它們可能作為人工伪影傳播到重建的關節軌跡中。基於小損失假設和在噪聲標籤學習文獻中建立的訓練動態樣本選擇，我們提出了一個新框架來檢測噪聲關鍵點標註。一個混合卷積-注意力模型被訓練來根據每個關鍵點的空間坐標和局部視覺特徵預測其解剖類別；隨後，得到的交叉熵訓練動態被用來推導每個關鍵點描述符，這些描述符通過無監督聚類被劃分為乾淨和噪聲子集。我們在NeoPose上驗證了該方法，這是一個新收集的65名住院早產嬰兒的數據集，並在多個噪聲水平下的兩種現實噪聲場景（隨機位置擾動和左右交換）中進行測試。結果顯示，所提出的方法在噪聲關鍵點檢測中達到了高達91.9%的F1分數。該框架進一步推廣到異質的COCO基準，從訓練集中過濾CE檢測的噪聲關鍵點也在中到高噪聲水平下帶來了可測量的改進（高達7.4 AP點）在下游姿勢估計準確性上。
